D1_LOOP_DYNAMICS_TRIAXIS.claim: Loop stability cannot be classified from state-delta/contraction alone. Controlled traces require at least state dynamics + unresolved residual/pressure + verified task-utility or marginal-value evidence to distinguish convergence, stagnation and stable overthinking.
D1_LOOP_DYNAMICS_TRIAXIS.counterhypothesis: A simpler two-axis dynamics+residual controller may suffice on real H1 episodes if outcome utility is redundant with residual pressure.
D1_LOOP_DYNAMICS_TRIAXIS.falsifier: Ubuntu H1 matched replay shows no incremental predictive/control value from task-utility/marginal-value beyond dynamics+residual axes.

D2_TRANSACTION_BOUND_LOOP_EFFECT.claim: Consequential recurrent decisions/effects should bind to an atomic snapshot/read-set and execution trace identity. In the exact synthetic corpus, unguarded per-field reads produced 700/1400 decision mismatches, including 300 unsafe effects and 400 missed effects; snapshot/root-guarded commit with deterministic retry produced zero tested mismatches, unsafe effects, missed effects or fractured snapshots.
D2_TRANSACTION_BOUND_LOOP_EFFECT.counterhypothesis: A deterministic single-owner scheduler or actor partition can provide equivalent safety without general snapshot transactions.
D2_TRANSACTION_BOUND_LOOP_EFFECT.falsifier: Target-Harness implementation preserves all invariant/effect decisions and replay under exhaustive relevant schedules without snapshot/read-set equivalent guards.

D3_TEMPORAL_PHASE_COHERENCE.claim: Per-mode stability is insufficient to infer schedule-family stability. A synthetic switched-system counterexample has two modes each with spectral radius 0.8 while alternating composition has spectral radius >2.08 and amplifies state strongly. Scheduler jitter/timing must therefore be an explicit intervention and receipt surface for multirate FRANK loops.
counterhypotheses: A deterministic scheduler makes schedule-family robustness irrelevant on authoritative paths.
A common contraction/Lyapunov certificate across relevant modes may prove arbitrary switching safe.
Slow derived state may tolerate jitter when epoch-tagged and excluded from authority.
D3_TEMPORAL_PHASE_COHERENCE.falsifier: Relevant target loop operators share a verified common robustness certificate or schedule fuzzing shows no semantic/outcome divergence across bounded target jitter classes.

D4_DB_TRANSACTION_BROKER.claim: Current ClayCode semantics can plausibly express bounded DB transactions through typed host resources/FFI without a DB-specific core primitive. Local proxy evidence includes 2000 randomized differential sequences, stable generated identity across runtime handles, and rollback-on-disconnect after forced guest exit.
D4_DB_TRANSACTION_BROKER.counterhypothesis: A first-class transaction construct is required to preserve rollback/replay semantics without hidden backend escape hatches.
D4_DB_TRANSACTION_BROKER.falsifier: A required general-purpose or FRANK DB semantic cannot be represented, checked and replayed through generic typed IR + runtime ABI/stdlib.

D5_RECURRENT_SAFE_EFFECT_NONAMPLIFICATIO.claim: Recurrence budget/continuation must never widen effect authority. Safe-Effect receipts should track recurrence/episode id, attempt count, retry reason, cumulative resource cost, capability identity, rollback/checkpoint and repeated denial while keeping loop-control values separate from permission.
D5_RECURRENT_SAFE_EFFECT_NONAMPLIFICATIO.counterhypothesis: Existing external capability gateway already enforces non-amplification, so only observability/test coverage changes are required.
D5_RECURRENT_SAFE_EFFECT_NONAMPLIFICATIO.falsifier: Frozen capability/effect contracts prove recurrence cannot change effective authority and H1 adversarial recurrence tests show no amplification without additional runtime rules.

D6_HWP02_LEDGER_COMPETING_LINEAGES.claim: Two distinct executable H-WP-02 StateLedger lineages now coexist and must not be silently treated as one implementation. One line uses research_entity/harness/reference_state_ledger.py with a semantic-root/event-chain split; the newer line uses research_entity/harness/reference/state_ledger.py with typed canonicalization, domain epochs, semantic/execution chains and trace_root_hash. Both have local passing receipts, but their semantic identity definitions differ.
D6_HWP02_LEDGER_COMPETING_LINEAGES.contradiction: Both claim H-WP-02 progress but encode different canonicalization/identity/state schema choices; neither is target-Ubuntu/live-frankv0.1 evidence and H-WP-02 remains incomplete.
D6_HWP02_LEDGER_COMPETING_LINEAGES.required_resolution: Run the same golden transaction/replay corpus through both implementations, classify semantic mismatches, select or merge only evidence-backed invariants, then freeze one H1 oracle path. Preserve the losing lineage as superseded/negative evidence rather than deleting it.
D6_HWP02_LEDGER_COMPETING_LINEAGES.promotion_block: H-WP-02_COMPLETE and H1 release claims remain blocked until this lineage conflict plus live-baseline/Ubuntu/crash/recovery/ClayGraph differential tests are resolved.

clayresearch.feedback: Fuse the tri-axis loop controller, transaction-bound effect envelope, timing robustness envelope and recurrence authority non-amplification into one minimal control/receipt architecture. Treat the competing H-WP-02 ledgers as an explicit architecture adjudication problem, not convergence evidence.

frank.feedback: Model each consequential recurrent cycle with separate semantic-program identity, execution/snapshot identity, schedule/timing receipt and fixed external authority. No Frank self-observation may authorize Harness changes; Research Entity remains the independent implementation authority.

gwt.feedback: Extend delay_changed tests to schedule-family/jitter sweeps. GWT selection/ignition may route recurrence but must not grant authority; evaluate outcome utility as a separate axis from residual pressure and dynamics.

emergenz.feedback: Add timing/schedule interventions and the tri-axis outcome test to recurrence/emergence experiments. Preserve recurrence != emergence and numerical stability != cognitive usefulness.

claycode.feedback: Prioritize generic structured control, typed runtime resource/transaction ABI, schedule/time receipts and separate semantic-vs-execution identity. Current evidence argues against FRANK-specific loop or DB transaction core primitives absent a production counterexample.

hyperposition.feedback: Treat delay/timescale/schedule class as active higher-order coupling variables. Test whether preserved alternatives recover stalled/overthinking regimes without violating transaction snapshot or authority boundaries.

claygraph.feedback: Dynamic Run ClayGraphs should bind pre/post semantic state hash, execution/trace root, schedule class/timing receipt, transaction conflicts/retries and causal loop edges while keeping graph activation non-authoritative.

unifieddb.feedback: Persist semantic identity separately from execution/provenance identity; support invariant-group snapshot/read-set conflicts, domain epochs, deterministic retry/replay and timing receipts. Do not choose between competing H-WP-02 ledgers without differential evidence.

harness.feedback: H-WP-02 has real executable progress but currently has two competing ledger lineages. Before completion, differential-test them on one golden corpus, then integrate the selected contract with H-WP-11 TurnTraceEnvelope, crash injection, schedule fuzzing, dynamic ClayGraph and exact Ubuntu frankv0.1 baseline replay.

global_controls: Ubuntu Linux developer system is the only Frank v0.1 release target
Android/mobile/edge is out of Frank v0.1 scope until owner reopens
shared ancestry and cross-branch repetition are not independent replication
synthetic/local proxy evidence cannot promote live target claims
loop stability, GWT, novelty, recurrence or emergence readouts never mint truth or effect authority
canonical revision remains unchanged absent promotion-grade evidence
